note: Claude Code が作る物語の動画（Seedance 2.5・Runware）。items に { id, prompt, first?, last?, refs?, duration?, resolution?, audio? } を足して push すると作る（id ごとに1回。作り直しは redo に id）。保存先 apps/web/public/onboarding/m<id>.mp4（720×1280・1MB以下）。めやす：720p 約35円/秒、480p 約15円/秒。 parallel：同時に作る本数（既定1。残高に余裕があれば4）。
always: Vertical 9:16 cinematic shot for a Japanese mobile story game: highly detailed dark fantasy with glowing gold light, the finest anime film quality, smooth camera. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.

items.prompt: The gold compass-rose seal on the floating envelope glows brighter and slowly turns; golden light seeps out along the envelope's edges; the flap lifts open and a parchment invitation card slides up out of the envelope, rising and growing until it stands upright filling the frame, surrounded by golden sparkles in black starry space. The card is completely blank, no writing. Camera slowly pushes in. Sound: only quiet sound effects that match the action (magical shimmer, paper, wings, wind, rumble, smoke) — no music, no voices, no speech.

By magic, the blank parchment invitation card lifts off and folds itself crease by crease — corners tucking in, wings forming — into a white-and-gold origami crane, which spreads its wings among drifting gold sparkles in black starry space, glowing softly at its folds. Smooth, graceful, continuous origami motion. Sound: only quiet sound effects that match the action (magical shimmer, paper, wings, wind, rumble, smoke) — no music, no voices, no speech.

The white origami crane glides on through glowing golden clouds, then dives down toward a black-and-gold city of tall spires under a sunset sky, flies along the polished stone avenue and vanishes into the light of the great gate; the camera follows and settles, looking straight at the gate. Sound: only quiet sound effects that match the action (magical shimmer, paper, wings, wind, rumble, smoke) — no music, no voices, no speech.

Almost still shot of the same picture: the golden clouds drift very slowly across the sunset sky, lights twinkle along the spires and the floor, a few gold motes float upward. Locked-off camera, no cuts, seamless loop.

A single unbroken take with no cuts and no jumps: a slow, steady dolly forward along the polished stone avenue toward the great gate, never stopping. As the camera travels, the giant doors swing shut with a heavy rumble and the golden light inside narrows to a thin line and goes out. The camera keeps moving forward smoothly until the closed dark doors fill the frame; black smoke wells up from the floor in front of them, and out of the smoke rises a tall hooded figure in a long black robe with fine gold patterns, a single golden eye glowing under the hood, a large golden magic-circle halo lighting up behind his head. Sound: only quiet sound effects that match the action (magical shimmer, paper, wings, wind, rumble, smoke) — no music, no voices, no speech.

In pitch-black space a bright golden star flares; golden light particles spiral in and gather into a long slender cream-and-gold space ticket that settles upright, glowing softly. The ticket has no writing.

The hooded gatekeeper in front of the gate slowly lowers his gaze and opens his gloved hands; a slender golden space ticket floats down, glowing, and hovers above his palms; a golden magic circle lights up on the floor.

A single unbroken take with no cuts: the camera, close before the great glowing gate, turns smoothly sideways and around, as if the viewer looks back over the shoulder at the voice that called; a few steps away on the stone avenue stands a small fox-masked character in a deep-red hooded robe with round dark sunglasses, already facing the camera, hands on hips, his fan of white, black and red tail feathers spreading open behind him. The camera settles on him. This fox-masked character's eyes never open: only thin glowing blue slits on the white mask, no other eyes anywhere. Sound: only quiet sound effects that match the action (magical shimmer, paper, wings, wind, rumble, smoke) — no music, no voices, no speech.

The small fox-masked character in the red robe stops, turns away from the tall hooded gatekeeper to face the camera directly, and the camera moves in close to his face (round dark sunglasses over his eyes). This fox-masked character's eyes never open: only thin glowing blue slits on the white mask, no other eyes anywhere.

In the golden temple hall, around the base of the pillar of light under the floating black sphere, the polished floor glows along a circle and slides open, revealing a long spiral stone staircase winding down into candle-lit darkness; the camera tilts down into it.

First-person descent down a long spiral stone staircase lit by candles in a deep round shaft; at the bottom it opens into a vast carved stone hall with red banners and a magic circle on the floor, where a slender black rocket with gold ornaments and pink-cyan neon lines stands; the camera settles looking at the rocket.
Close-up: the translucent oval stone resting on the open palm glows; golden light swirls slowly inside it, mixed with blue light and tiny sparkles; its glow gently pulses. Very slight camera push-in.

The rocket's hatch closes; candle flames flicker and dust stirs as its three nozzles ignite; it rises up the long round shaft, bursts out into the night and climbs through black space away from the blue Earth.

The rocket cruises through space; the grey cratered Moon grows ahead; it glides down over the lunar surface toward a white temple with blue magic-circle floors inside a crater and lands gently beside it, dust drifting; the camera settles high above the temple with the Earth in the sky.

The camera glides down from above the white moon temple, through its arches, into the marble interior where a round shallow water basin lies in the centre of the blue magic circles and a black sphere floats in a pillar of light above it.

The giant white-scaled dragon in the red fox-hood robe, his dozens of muscular arms raised, pops all his party crackers at once — streams of colourful confetti and paper ribbons burst and rain down through the moon temple, light sticks waving. This fox-masked character's eyes never open: only thin glowing blue slits on the white mask, no other eyes anywhere.

The pillar of light around the black sphere stretches out and reaches deep into the temple; the camera follows it to a small white marble altar where two yin-yang eggs (a sun-and-moon egg and an earth-and-moon egg) light up side by side.

The glowing gemstone in front of the sun-and-moon yin-yang egg flares; warm golden light streams into the egg; a crack runs across its shell with light bursting through; the shell splits open in a flash of warm light that fills the frame.

The glowing gemstone in front of the earth-and-moon yin-yang egg flares; blue light streams into the egg; a crack runs across its shell with light bursting through; the shell splits open in a flash of blue-white light that fills the frame.

The earth-and-moon yin-yang egg on the altar cracks; out bounces a cute shiny round creature shaped like a brown swirl soft-serve shell with a golden band and golden stars, big glossy eyes and rosy cheeks, smiling, hopping happily on the altar.

The sun-and-moon yin-yang egg on the altar cracks; out bounces a cute shiny round creature shaped like a brown swirl soft-serve shell with a golden band and golden stars, big glossy eyes and rosy cheeks, smiling, hopping happily on the altar.
Night on the Moon: the white temple in its crater, the blue Earth hanging in the black sky, a few lights glowing inside; the camera slowly pulls back and up, very calm and quiet.

Close-up: the small fox-masked character raises one white gloved hand and pushes his round dark sunglasses up off his face onto the top of his hood, with a confident little tilt of the head. This fox-masked character's eyes never open: only thin glowing blue slits on the white mask, no other eyes anywhere.

Comedy beat in the dark-gold hall with golden armillary spheres and a thin pillar of light: the small fox-masked character in the red robe jumps back in shock at the floating black sphere, leaning far back with his arms flung up and his fan of tail feathers bristling, then freezes, staring. This fox-masked character's eyes never open: only thin glowing blue slits on the white mask, no other eyes anywhere.

Seen from behind, the small fox-masked character struts happily out through the glowing gate, his fan of tail feathers swishing left and right in rhythm as if he were humming; then he turns into a bright point of light and shoots up into the sunset sky, vanishing among the clouds. This fox-masked character's eyes never open: only thin glowing blue slits on the white mask, no other eyes anywhere.

Comedy beat: a bright point of light streaks back down from the sky and screeches to a halt in front of the great gate, becoming the small fox-masked character in the red robe; he immediately dashes at tremendous speed through the gate and into the dark-gold hall with golden armillary spheres and a thin pillar of light, skidding to a stop, bent over and panting, clutching a golden ticket to his chest. In the candle-lit launch pit, behind the tall hooded gatekeeper, eight blank golden cards rise one after another out of thin air with a soft glow and settle into a wide arc above and behind him.

The eight golden cards behind the gatekeeper dissolve into streams of golden light particles that swirl down toward the camera and pour into an old brown leather book held in two hands, which closes with a soft golden glow.

Inside the rocket with purple and cyan neon: the small fox-masked character stands at the big window gazing down at the glowing night Earth below; sushi plates glide along the lane; the camera slowly drifts closer. This fox-masked character's eyes never open: only thin glowing blue slits on the white mask, no other eyes anywhere.

This fox-masked character's eyes never open: only thin glowing blue slits on the white mask, no other eyes anywhere.

The giant many-armed dragon glows, shrinks and folds back in a swirl of light and water drops, becoming again the small fox-masked character in the red robe, now with one little white dragon wing between his tail feathers and his round sunglasses up on his hood. This fox-masked character's eyes never open: only thin glowing blue slits on the white mask, no other eyes anywhere.

The camera takes a slow, steady step forward along the polished stone avenue toward the great open gate glowing with golden light, as if the viewer walks into its light, and comes to a stop close in front of it. One continuous shot. Sound: only quiet sound effects that match the action (magical shimmer, paper, wings, wind, rumble, smoke) — no music, no voices, no speech.
